needs_atom.missing: ENGINE: a cost with {T} and a tap-another part never taps its source. '{T}, Tap ten untapped Elves you control' is Cost(CostTap(), CostTap(target = 10 untapped Elves you control, FNot(IS_SOURCE))); legality.pay_costs replaces the plan's taps (the source among them) with _ask_cost_choices' picks whenever the plan records tap_options, so the {T} is never paid: Lathril drains 10 and stays untapped, free to attack, block or activate again (stronger than printed). And the tap lane offers the source itself to the tap-another part: without FNot(IS_SOURCE), Lathril and nine other Elves paid it (CR 601.2h, 602.2b: tapped for {T}, she is not one of the ten untapped Elves). The combat-damage trigger plays right.
